messages.content:
Hey there! Welcome to Release EDU! I'm Bob, and I'm genuinely excited to get to know you. My job is to figure out what makes you tick so we can build you an amazing learning experience that's completely tailored to YOU.

So let's jump right in — what's something that really excites you or gets you fired up? Could be anything at all — a hobby, a subject, something you love to do, or even just something you've been curious about lately!

teacherConfig.customInstructions: Emphasize connections between CS and mathematics. Encourage project-based thinking.
